_comment: split, as the engine runs it. Every file in this directory is read by
split(value, sep) is the list of parts; split(value, sep, index) is one of
them. Parts are trimmed, an omitted or empty sep is a comma, and text with
nothing in it has no parts -- the list Data Conversion's Array target makes
from the same text. A value that is already a list is used as it is, and
a number splits as the digits it is shown as, never as 1.704207845e+09.
A negative index counts from the end. An index that is not a whole number,
or is past either end, is null, so coalesce can supply a default.
